r_function: weighted.mean() centroids per bucket; stats::dist() euclidean / manhattan / maximum, squared euclidean, cosine 1 - a.b/(|a||b|), sqrt(stats::mahalanobis()) over the pooled within-bucket covariance; standardize z-scores the centroids by the bucketed rows' mean and sd (scale()).
note: Weights follow the one rule: w* = w * N*/sum(w), N* = sum(w) (frequency, asserted on the rep()-expanded rows) or Kish n_eff (probability); centroids are kind-free weighted means, the sd and the pooled covariance are frequency formulas on w*. buckets = each row's bucket number in Pulse's emission order (1-based); sizes = per-bucket sum of weights, counts = rows. mahalanobis reads the raw centroids whatever standardize says (it is affine-invariant).
